project: CP2B — Mapeamento de Resíduos Agroindustriais SP

01_master_residue_streams_SP_2023.csv.description: Long-format. One row per municipality × residue stream. Use for all analysis.

key_columns.residue_tons_yr: Gross residue mass (dry tons/yr). NULL for pre-calc streams.
key_columns.biogas_m3_yr: Technical biogas potential (m³ CH4/yr). Bagaço excluded (70% cana).
key_columns.biogas_m3_per_km2: m³ CH4/km²/yr. For spatial density analysis.
key_columns.mun_potential_class: BAIXO | MÉDIO | ALTO | MUITO ALTO | CRÍTICO (based on total GWh)
key_columns.mun_dominant_stream: Stream with highest biogas_m3_yr in that municipality

02_municipality_summary_SP_2023.csv.description: Wide-format. One row per municipality. GWh columns per stream. Use for clustering.

03_conversion_factors.csv.description: Referenced conversion factors with safety margins. Source for biogas calculations.

04_state_summary_by_stream.csv.description: SP state totals per residue stream. Use for Paper Table 1.

methodology.bagaco_exclusion: 70% of sugarcane biogas excluded — bagaço burned for cogeneration at mills
methodology.conversion_units: m³ CH4/ton for crops; m³ CH4/head/yr for livestock
methodology.missing_streams: Industrial (brewery, dairy, slaughterhouse) not in SQLite DB — need PostgreSQL
methodology.data_sources: IBGE PAM 2023 (crops), IBGE PPM 2023 (livestock), CP2B municipalities DB

clustering_suggestions: K-means on [GWh_sugarcane, GWh_cattle, GWh_swine, GWh_rsu_organic, GWh_corn, GWh_soybean]
Profile clusters by nm_rgint (Intermediate Geographic Region) for policy targeting
Dominant stream classification already in mun_dominant_stream column
